Most previews back Boston at about -150 to -164 (roughly 59-62%): Doc's Sports, Bang The Book, BettorsInsider and Sports Interaction all take the Bruins, citing better goaltending and defense (2.62-2.65 goals against vs Winnipeg's 3.27), home ice and three days' rest against a Jets team that just flew east. Five of six sources pick Dallas, priced about -170 (59-63%): the Stars have won five straight, holding every opponent to three goals or fewer, and Oettinger shut out Pittsburgh 1-0 last time. Most expect a tight game: projections run 4-3 (iHeart, Bleacher Nation) to 4-2 (CappersPicks), and four of Dallas' last five wins were by one goal. The contrarian view is Dimers' model, which gives Nashville 41.2% and calls the Predators moneyline the value bet; Nashville is 4-1 as a +140-or-longer underdog and won the earlier meeting. Saros vs Oettinger expected, both unconfirmed. Dallas is thin on defense (Bichsel, Capobianco out; Myers day-to-day).
